$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F09 GCD detail (A6): the right temple and hinge from the front right, a 4:5 crop of the landscape shot on the hinge. The engraved wordmark and the old emblem come off the temple; the GCD is placed with the old print as a ruler (24.1 to 39.9 mm from the hinge, from the left profile, IMG_3402). The temple's lit outer face starts below its top face and a dark bevel; those two lines were measured by hand (temple_gcd.py --edges).

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges)
